svg.title: F126.4 flips, re-grade and better or worse: the architecture

g.text: F126.4 flips, re-grade and better or worse: the architecture
flip (4), re-grade (9), better or worse (10), copy (11)
the flip (2), the comparison and the history (8)
same answer, same mark (5), the re-grader (6)
a line has the colour of the box it leaves

text.tspan: The web's pages call the eval routes through their client. A flip changes the run's file under the store's lock. A re-grade goes through the desk, and the re-grader asks the judge only for what
changed, recording into the live run's play. The records both sides share hold the flip, the comparison and the history. The number in brackets is the step.
